patch_description:
The best-performing prior variant (score 0.89) used a *doubled* block (same shared parameter names repeated twice) to increase circuit depth without increasing parameter count, which visibly improved validation/test accuracy relative to the single-block variant (score 0.86, our current file). The current program regressed by dropping this depth-doubling structure.

This edit reinstates the double-block depth strategy while keeping the useful additions from the current program (mirrored RX layer, mid-circuit mirrored RZ layer, skip-2 entanglers, diameter entanglers). Additionally, per the recommendation, the antipodal ("diameter") CRZ layer is split into two hierarchically-shared parameters (`crz_diam_even` for pairs [0,4] & [2,6], `crz_diam_odd` for pairs [1,5] & [3,7]) instead of one single shared parameter, giving slightly richer long-range mixing at only +1 parameter cost. The whole enriched block is then duplicated (reusing identical parameter names) to double depth exactly as in the strongest prior candidate, which should recover the depth-driven generalization benefit while retaining the extra mid-phase and diameter structure.
